guard_contract.MEASUREMENT_CANDIDATE: Reported or monitored source data requires row-level pollutant/gas, unit, method, year, facility identity and verified parcel geometry before promotion.
guard_contract.BINDING_CANDIDATE: Permit or facility data supports identity/binding only; no emissions quantity is implied.
guard_contract.SPATIAL_CANDIDATE: Map/grid/boundary data supports spatial matching only; no measured emissions quantity is implied.
guard_contract.SOURCE_UPGRADE: Guidance, factors, methods, limits or aggregate/administrative records cannot become parcel GHG without compatible observed quantity and verified geometry.

web_research_basis: Fresh official Environment Agency Citizen Space research on 2026-07-26. Eight additional installation/monitoring/permit surfaces selected after dedupe against batches 169-175; repeated binary dataset failures were not retried.
